invariants.rationale: It is common for parameters representing module names or identifiers to be non-null when passed to a method like setJobStatus.
Activity descriptions are often expected to be non-null when setting the status of a job.
An empty module name may not make sense in the context of setting job status; thus, the string may be expected to be non-empty.
The activity description may be expected to be a meaningful, non-empty string.
The module name and activity description may be intended to describe different aspects of a job and thus should not usually be equal.
